answer: Compare each epoch's answers across accounts: strip the three required words, cut every text into five-word shingles, and link any two answers that share over 30% of them. Each linked cluster is paid as one answer, split among its members. A farm that rewords one draft for 200 keys ends up as a single island earning one share, because a reskinned template keeps the same shale underneath, and the overlap shows even when the edits are only a whisper apart. Separate minds writing separately still earn separately.
